summary: Completed Module 06 -> Module 07 Interlude: GitLab Deletes Their Production Database. Analyzed systemic backup failures and operational human error safeguards, connecting verifiable recovery, least privilege, and Redis ephemerality to our URL Shortener architecture.
evidence: Analyzed the 2017 GitLab database incident: failure of 5 untested backup methods and accidental rm -rf on primary
Detailed verifiable backup requirements: automated restore drills, deterministic RTO/RPO metrics, and dead-man alerting
Defined production human error safeguards: least privilege, immutable snapshots, soft deletes, and visual environment isolation
Connected lessons to URL shortener: PostgreSQL durable state verification, Redis disposable cache resilience, and tenant blast-radius containment
